class.name: GIFPlayer
class.brief_description: Control node for animated GIF playback.
class.description: GIFPlayer is a [Control] node that displays and plays animated GIFs. Provides playback controls, multiple play modes, and display options similar to [TextureRect]. Automatically advances frames based on the GIF's delay timing.

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the currently displayed frame index.

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the total number of frames in [member gif], or [code]0[/code] if no texture is assigned.

method.name: play
method.description: Enables playback from the current frame, clears [member paused], and restarts the frame timer. This requires a valid [member gif] with at least one frame.

method.name: set_frame
method.description: Displays the frame at the given zero-based index and restarts the frame timer. The playback and pause states are preserved.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback and resets to the first frame.

members.member: Controls how the GIF's dimensions contribute to the control's minimum size. See [enum ExpandMode]. Use [member stretch_mode] to control how the GIF is drawn inside the control.
The GIF texture to display and animate. Assigning a texture resets the current frame and loop counter. Use separate [GIFTexture] instances for players that need independent playback.
The number of times to play the animation. [code]0[/code] repeats indefinitely. Negative values use the loop count from [member gif]. [constant PLAY_MODE_RANDOM] ignores this limit.
If [code]true[/code], pauses active playback and keeps the current frame visible. Set this to [code]false[/code] to resume. This property reads as [code]false[/code] when playback is stopped.
The order in which frames are played. See [enum PlayMode].
Whether playback is enabled. Setting this to [code]true[/code] calls [method play] and setting it to [code]false[/code] calls [method stop]. Use [member paused] to pause without resetting the frame.

The playback speed multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] uses the original frame timing, [code]2.0[/code] plays at double speed, and [code]0.0[/code] prevents frames from advancing. Negative values are clamped to [code]0.0[/code].
Controls how the GIF is drawn inside the control's rectangle, including scaling, tiling, and alignment. See [enum StretchMode].

constants.constant: Uses the original GIF height as the minimum height and leaves the minimum width unconstrained.
Uses the original GIF dimensions as the minimum size. Use [member stretch_mode] to control the drawn aspect ratio.
Uses the original GIF width as the minimum width and leaves the minimum height unconstrained.
Uses the same minimum size as [constant EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT_PROPORTIONAL].
Lets the control shrink below the GIF's original size.
Uses the original GIF dimensions as the minimum size.
Chooses a random frame at each step. The same frame can be chosen again, and [member loop_count] is ignored.
Keep the original size, position at top-left.
Scale to fit while preserving aspect ratio. May leave empty space.
Scale to fit while preserving aspect ratio, centered.
Scale to cover the entire rect while preserving aspect ratio. May crop the image.
Keep the original size, centered in the rect.
Stretch to fill the entire control rect.
Tile the image to fill the rect.
